notes.title: Announcing our new game!
notes.content: [p]We're excited to finally reveal what we've been quietly building: [b]Poly Bricks[/b] — a cozy, creative brick-building game coming to Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]Poly Bricks is designed to capture the joy of building sets on your bedroom floor. Follow step-by-step instructions to assemble detailed sets brick-by-brick, relax into the flow, and rediscover that satisfying childhood rhythm of construction.[/p][p][/p][p]In [b]Story Mode[/b], you’ll work through dozens of curated sets across a range of themes and difficulty levels. Once complete, proudly display your creations in your customizable virtual room and grow your personal collection over time.[/p][p][/p][p]But that’s just the beginning.[/p][p][/p][p]Poly Bricks also puts a strong emphasis on [b]community and creativity[/b]. Through [b]online multiplayer[/b], you can collaborate in real time with friends, building sets together or designing completely original creations.[/p][p][/p][p]Using an in-game 3D printer, players can craft their own bricks from a variety of base shapes—rectangles, slopes, cylinders, trapezoids, and more. You can even import your own 3D models and custom stickers to truly make each set your own.[/p][p][/p][p]We have big plans for Poly Bricks and plenty of ideas still in development. We can’t wait to share more with you.[/p][p][/p][p]If you like what you see, please add Poly Bricks to your Wishlist to follow our progress and get notified of future updates.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being part of the journey.[/p][p][/p][p]— Patrick and the Poly Bricks Team[/p]
